Bug_Title: Identical expressions should not be used on both sides of a binary operator
Bug_Explanation: The bug in this code is demonstrated by using identical expressions on both sides of a binary operator. In the first part of the code, the expressions 'a == a' and 'a!= a' are always true and false respectively, which are not useful and can be considered as bugs. In the second part of the code, the expression 'a << a' is used which is noncompliant because it is using identical expressions on both sides of a binary operator.
